args.summary:
Model built successfully for a 5-span precast prestressed T-girder bridge (20+25+25+25+20 m), simply supported during erection and continuous in service (structure.system = continuous; pier column geometry was not given, so support lines are modelled as bearings on rigid supports).

Key modelling decisions:
- Idealization: 2D spine beam (MR-01), continuous system (MR-05).
- Girder: 4 precast T-girders/span combined into one spine. Single mid-girder section integrated to A = 0.802 m², I = 0.29404 m⁴; combined A = 3.208 m², I = 1.17616 m⁴ (MR-02). C50 → Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1); w = 83.408 kN/m, m = 8.5023 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric at supports 0,1,2,4,5 (longitudinally free) and plain laminated elastomeric fixed at support 3; one per girder end × 4 girders = 4 bearings/line (MR-03, MR-04). a×b = 300×350 mm, 4×8 mm layers → te = 0.032 m, S = 10.096, Ge = 1.0 MPa, Kv = 5.665×10⁶ kN/m, and Kh = 13125 kN/m only at the fixed line 3 (Kh = 0 for sliding lines).
- Live load: Class I, two-way, carriageway 9 m → 2 design lanes (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1); ξ = 1.0, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 300 kN (20 m spans) / 310 kN (25 m spans).

Results:
- Fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 6.033 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.1767·ln(f1) − 0.0157 = 0.3019 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).
- Self-weight reactions: 622.8 kN (abutments), ~2082–2091 kN (piers).
- Self-weight midspan moments: 2058–2220 kN·m; support hogging: −4226 to −4368 kN·m.
- Max lane positive moment 4815 kN·m (span 3); max lane negative moment −3522 kN·m.

All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
